description: This file contains source code for unit testing DynamoDB storage interactions in the AWSUtils project. It defines data models for DynamoDB items and a test implementation of DynamoDB storage for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: UnitTestDynamoDBTableData
classes.description: A serializable data model class representing DynamoDB table items for unit testing, with properties for partition key, row key, ETag, binary data, and string data, along with methods for cloning and string representation.

classes.name: UnitTestDynamoDBStorage
classes.description: A test implementation of DynamoDB storage used for unit testing DynamoDB operations. It initializes a DynamoDB table with a specific schema if the DynamoDB service is available.

methods.name: UnitTestDynamoDBTableData()
methods.description: Default constructor for the data model.

methods.name: UnitTestDynamoDBTableData(Dictionary<string, AttributeValue> fields)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data model from a dictionary of DynamoDB attribute values.

methods.name: UnitTestDynamoDBTableData(string data, string partitionKey, string rowKey)
methods.description: Constructor to create a data item with specified string data, partition key, and row key.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current data item.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the data model containing partition key, row key, and ETag.
